description: Place a file (image, PDF, text, InDesign snippet...) on a spread at a point (Spread.place)

filePath.description: Absolute path to the file to place (must be inside the allowed directories)

layerName.description: Name of an existing layer to place on (default: active layer)

showingOptions.description: Show the import options dialog (modal: blocks until a user closes it in InDesign)

x.description: X of the place point in mm, measured from the ruler origin (spread origin by default)

y.description: Y of the place point in mm, measured from the ruler origin

name: place_file_on_spread
title: Place File On Spread
